refnamediv.refpurpose: APIs for querying and changing the system hostname and related machine metadata.

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Hostname is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.
APIs for querying and changing the system hostname and related machine metadata.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# APIs for querying and changing the system hostname and related machine metadata. interface io.systemd.Hostname
# Returns hostname, kernel, OS, hardware, firmware and other machine metadata in one call. method Describe( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # The current system hostname. Hostname: string, # The statically configured hostname, from /etc/hostname. Null if none is configured. StaticHostname: ?string, # The pretty (free-form, UTF-8) hostname. Null if none is configured. PrettyHostname: ?string, # The fallback hostname used when neither a static nor a transient hostname is set. DefaultHostname: ?string, # Indicates where the current hostname originates from, one of 'static', 'transient' or 'default'. HostnameSource: string, # The name of an icon representing this system, following the XDG icon naming spec. Null if none is configured. IconName: ?string, # The chassis type of this system, e.g. 'desktop', 'laptop', 'server', 'vm', … Null if unknown. Chassis: ?string, # An unique identifier of the system chassis. ChassisAssetTag: ?string, # The deployment environment of this system, e.g. 'production' or 'staging'. Null if none is configured. Deployment: ?string, # A human-readable description of the physical location of this system. Null if none is configured. Location: ?string, # The operating system kernel name, as reported by uname(2), e.g. 'Linux'. KernelName: string, # The kernel release string, as reported by uname(2). KernelRelease: string, # The kernel version string, as reported by uname(2). KernelVersion: string, # 'Pretty' name of the OS. This is the primary OS identifier that is suitable for presentation to the user. Typically includes a version too, but doesn't have to. OperatingSystemPrettyName: ?string, # 'Fancy' name of the OS; may contain non-ASCII Unicode chars, as well as basic ANSI sequences. This is similar to 'OperatingSystemPrettyName', but is preferably used on terminals that support ANSI sequences and full Unicode. OperatingSystemFancyName: ?string, # The CPE name of the OS, from the CPE_NAME= field of os-release. OperatingSystemCPEName: ?string, # The home URL of the OS, from the HOME_URL= field of os-release. OperatingSystemHomeURL: ?string, # The end-of-support time of the OS, in µs since the UNIX epoch. Null if not known. OperatingSystemSupportEnd: ?int, # The full contents of os-release, as an array of 'KEY=VALUE' strings. OperatingSystemReleaseData: ?[]string, # The OS image identifier, from the IMAGE_ID= field of os-release. OperatingSystemImageID: ?string, # The OS image version, from the IMAGE_VERSION= field of os-release. OperatingSystemImageVersion: ?string, # The full contents of /etc/machine-info, as an array of 'KEY=VALUE' strings. MachineInformationData: ?[]string, # The hardware vendor of this system. Null if not known. HardwareVendor: ?string, # The hardware model of this system. Null if not known. HardwareModel: ?string, # The hardware serial number of this system. Reading it requires privileges. Null if not known. HardwareSerial: ?string, # The hardware SKU (stock keeping unit) of this system. Null if not known. HardwareSKU: ?string, # The hardware version of this system. Null if not known. HardwareVersion: ?string, # The firmware version of this system. Null if not known. FirmwareVersion: ?string, # The firmware vendor of this system. Null if not known. FirmwareVendor: ?string, # The firmware build date, in µs since the UNIX epoch. Null if not known. FirmwareDate: ?int, # The 128-bit machine ID of this system, formatted as a hexadecimal string. MachineID: string, # The 128-bit boot ID of the current boot, formatted as a hexadecimal string. BootID: string, # The DMI product UUID of this system. Reading it requires privileges. Null if not known. ProductUUID: ?string, # The AF_VSOCK context ID (CID) of this system. Null if not known. VSockCID: ?int )
# Sets the transient (runtime) hostname. method SetHostname( # The transient (runtime) hostname to set. If null the transient hostname is reset, so that the static hostname is used again. newValue: ?string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Sets the static hostname, stored in /etc/hostname. method SetStaticHostname( # The static hostname to set, stored in /etc/hostname. If null the static hostname is removed. newValue: ?string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Sets the pretty (free-form, UTF-8) hostname. method SetPrettyHostname( # The pretty (free-form, UTF-8) hostname to set. If null the pretty hostname is removed. newValue: ?string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Sets the icon name representing this system. method SetIconName( # The icon name to set. If null the icon name is removed. newValue: ?string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Sets the chassis type of this system. method SetChassis( # The chassis type to set. If null the chassis type is removed. newValue: ?string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Sets the deployment environment of this system. method SetDeployment( # The deployment environment to set. If null the deployment is removed. newValue: ?string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Sets the physical location of this system. method SetLocation( # The physical location to set. If null the location is removed. newValue: ?string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Edits the machine tag list: optionally resets it to 'set', then adds 'add' and removes 'remove'. method SetTags( # If specified, the machine tag list is first reset to exactly these tags, before the 'add' and 'remove' fields are applied. If null, the current tag list is used as basis instead. set: ?[]string, # Machine tags to add to the list. add: ?[]string, # Machine tags to remove from the list. remove: ?[]string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Hostname shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Hostname.Describe '{}' invokes its Describe method.
